_comment: T-2432 (design Sec2.5): one entry per geometry site the four grounding/temper/audit/fold passes found. `family` is R1 (re-derives hidden_size==num_attention_heads*head_dim), QOW (uses hidden_size as a stand-in for q_proj's/o_proj's true width), or KLP (assumes one K-landing path). `status` is fixed, confirmed-correct, rejected (a defined convert/load-time rejection, not a code fix), or not-yet-built (a Track this build did not own). GS-01..GS-04, GS-06..GS-19 are Track A's own scope (T-2432); GS-05 is Track B's (D-SLM5243), out of this ticket's scope and not yet built.

sites.note: Track B's own scope (D-SLM5243); a defined convert/load-time rejection, not built by T-2432.
